reason: I'm two waiters short, so anything that lets guests pay at the table without waiting for someone to bring the terminal is worth a try, and three free months costs me nothing. But it has to earn its 59 lari in the first paid month or I cancel it.
objection: A new startup holding my guests' contacts and payment history: if it folds in a year or sells the data to the place across the street, I've lost my regulars. I also don't know how big the payment partner's fee on top is.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that the guest list is mine and can be exported at any time, plus the exact per-transaction fee stated up front.
